geometry_edits.rationale: Introduce an explicit courtyard macro as the dominant mass operation to better express the required public void and active ground edge.
Increase carved openness while preserving the compact host.
Align the court opening with the verified access side.
Strengthen the entry/terrace seam at the ground plane.

graph_edits.rationale: Convert the primary massing into a more legible carved public void / courtyard response to the street edge, instead of a mostly sealed stepped block.
Open up a clearer, larger public void proportion so the mass reads as neighborhood-living with a usable court rather than decorative subtraction.
Align the void opening to the program-frame access side so the frontage becomes a legible threshold.
Lower and sharpen the terrace link to strengthen ground-level public continuity and make the entry seam more visible.

rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent mass in all four views, with a clear stepped/bent compact body and acceptable repair integrity. However, the public-space logic is weak: the visible road frontage edge is answered mostly by a sealed or indifferent base rather than a legible court, seam, or undercut. The silhouette is coherent but leans toward an arbitrary stacked wedge rather than a clearly program-bearing neighborhood-living section. It can plausibly support the brief at a generic level, but it does not yet make the required active ground threshold or public void. The references suggest a stronger courtyard/threshold relationship and a more explicit ground-level social space.
